topic: LIDAR capability for crosswalk traffic counting
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the technical feasibility of using LIDAR technology to count vehicles at a specific crossroads location. Concerns were raised regarding whether the distance required for counting exceeded the capabilities of the current LIDAR setup. It was clarified that 2D LIDAR units are not capable of monitoring traffic perpendicular to the screen surface, but they can count cars located adjacent to the screen.
decisions: The technical limitations of the 2D LIDAR regarding cross-street traffic counting were confirmed.
